metadata.name: Chemical and Isotopic Composition of Sediment Cores from Site 680
metadata.description: This dataset contains chemical composition, derived metrics, and isotopic data from sediment cores collected during Leg 112 of the Ocean Drilling Program. The samples were taken from a single location near the coast of Peru at coordinates -11.065 latitude and -78.07783 longitude, with an elevation of -272.0 units. The data includes measurements of major and trace elements, enrichment factors, and isotopic ratios, providing insights into the geological and environmental conditions of the Pleistocene epoch.
